headline: Fed officials expect more rate hikes, worry about AI impact on inflation
detail: This suggests continued pressure on growth and tech stocks, especially those sensitive to interest rates. Your leveraged tech ETFs are particularly vulnerable to this macro environment.
rec: Consider trimming leveraged positions like SOXL and PLTU given the hawkish Fed sentiment.

headline: Washington is scrambling to get to the bottom of the growing number of tech outages
detail: Widespread tech outages could signal underlying infrastructure issues or cyber threats, creating uncertainty for the tech sector. This could impact even strong names.
rec: Monitor this situation for any signs of systemic risk impacting your tech holdings.

headline: Nvidia reverses, metals crash ahead of Anthropic IPO
detail: Nvidia's reversal, even if temporary, highlights volatility in key chip names. The Anthropic IPO buzz and related selling pressure could spill over into other AI-related stocks.
rec: Stay vigilant on chip names and AI plays; volatility is high around major IPOs.
